expectations.text: States the proposal adds AI-related points of focus rather than creating new AI-specific criteria
expectations.evidence: the proposed refresh adds AI-related points of focus to the existing criteria. It does not add new AI-specific criteria... There is no standalone "AI criterion" and no separate AI category.

expectations.text: Dates the exposure draft to late October 2026, issued by the AICPA's Assurance Services Executive Committee
expectations.evidence: On October 28, 2026, the AICPA's Assurance Services Executive Committee issued the exposure draft... (dated October 27, 2026).

expectations.text: Explains points of focus are illustrative considerations, not mandatory requirements
expectations.evidence: AI appears as points of focus, which are guidance within criteria.

expectations.text: States today's audits evaluate AI systems under the existing 2017 criteria
expectations.evidence: Today your audit uses the 2017 Trust Services Criteria with the 2022 Revised Points of Focus, and your AI systems are examined through the existing criteria.

expectations.text: Notes the comment window is open until January 15, 2027 for AI-specific feedback
expectations.evidence: Comments are due January 15, 2027... Watch the exposure draft. Consider commenting by January 15, 2027.
